map.根据负载总功率、功率因数与电压等级，计算视在功率、计算电流，推荐标准变压器容量与: From the total load power, power factor and voltage level, compute the apparent power and load current, and recommend a standard transformer capacity and load rate.
map.由负载总功率 P 与功率因数 cosφ 计算视在功率 S，求计算电流 I，依据目: From total load power P and power factor cos phi compute the apparent power S, find the load current I, and recommend a standard transformer capacity based on the target load rate and assess whether the actual load rate is reasonable.
map.💡 视在功率 S=P/cosφ；计算电流 I=S/(√3×U)；变压器容量按 S: Tip: apparent power S = P / cos phi; load current I = S / (sqrt(3) times U); transformer capacity is selected as S / load rate against standard capacities.
map.最佳负载率 70%~85%，过低浪费投资，过高影响寿命: Best load rate 70 percent to 85 percent; too low wastes investment, too high shortens life
map.常用电压等级：0.4kV（低压）、10kV、35kV、110kV: Common voltage levels: 0.4 kV (low voltage), 10 kV, 35 kV, 110 kV
map.📚 深度解析：变压器选型（容量/负载率/无功补偿）: In-depth: Transformer Sizing (capacity / load rate / reactive compensation)
map.配电设计：由负荷功率与: Distribution design: compute apparent power from load power
map.容量校核：按目标负载率反推所需容量，看实际负载率是否合理: Capacity check: invert the required capacity from the target load rate and see if the actual load rate is reasonable
map.补偿配置：算无功功率，确定电容器柜容量: Compensation design: compute reactive power and determine capacitor bank capacity
map.算法：视在功率 S = P/cosφ（kVA）；计算电流 I = S/(√3×U: Algorithm: apparent power S = P / cos phi (kVA); load current I = S / (sqrt(3) times U) (A); theoretical required capacity = S / (target load rate / 100); round up to the standard series (30, 50, 63, 80, 100, up to 10000 kVA); actual load rate = S / recommended capacity times 100 percent; reactive power Q = P times tan(arccos cos phi) (kvar). Voltage levels: 0.4 kV or below low-voltage distribution, 10 kV or below distribution transformer, 35 kV or below regional substation, above 35 kV main substation. Load rate below 50 percent is low, 50 to 85 percent reasonable, 85 to 95 percent high, above 95 percent excessive.
map.例：200kW、cosφ=0.85、10kV、目标负载率 80% → S=235: Example: 200 kW, cos phi 0.85, 10 kV, target load rate 80 percent gives S = 235.3 kVA, current 13.6 A, theoretical capacity 294 kVA, take standard 315 kVA, actual load rate 74.7 percent (reasonable), reactive 123.9 kvar, classified as distribution transformer (10 kV). If 800 kW, cos phi 0.8, 0.4 kV, target 85 percent gives S = 1000 kVA, current 1443.4 A, theoretical 1176 kVA, take 1250 kVA, actual load rate 80 percent, reactive 600 kvar, belonging to low-voltage distribution (0.4 kV).
map.目标负载率为什么常取 80%？: Why is the target load rate often 80 percent?
map.变压器在 50%~80% 负载率时损耗比最优、寿命最长；预留 15%~25% 余: A transformer has the best loss ratio and longest life at 50 percent to 80 percent load; keeping 15 percent to 25 percent margin handles load growth and short overloads, and avoids long full-load operation that accelerates insulation aging from temperature rise.
map.用于配置无功补偿容量。若要求功率因数从 0.85 提到 0.95，可按 Qc =: To size reactive compensation. To raise the power factor from 0.85 to 0.95, compute the required compensation Qc = P times (tan phi1 minus tan phi2) (kvar), then select grouped switching of capacitor banks.
